videos.caption: Some people think because you deliver food you have to go along with anything. They see the job first. They forget there is a person behind it. Back home in Morocco respect comes before any request. You do not cross lines just because you can pay for something. Here it can feel different. Some act like the uniform means they get to decide the rules. My work does not erase my limits. It does not change what feels wrong. And it does not give anyone the right to treat me like less than a person. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #moroccangirl #explore #dontjudge
